entries.issue: No inspected public source observes the exact eight-component R161 contrast vector jointly.
entries.counterexample: Ruttle supplies rotation/localization without vibration; Le Franc supplies tendon vibration without bony control or R161 tool readout.
entries.repaired: Sources are typed as component evidence only and covariance borrowing is prohibited.
entries.unresolved: An undiscovered/private exact dataset or a new exact-protocol pilot could supply the joint vector.

entries.issue: Student and chi-square formulas require i.i.d. complete multivariate Gaussian participant vectors; clipping and min/max effects can violate approximation quality.
entries.counterexample: A point mass at clipping value one plus a skewed continuous component is bounded but non-Gaussian and can distort small-sample t coverage.
entries.repaired: Every theorem states the model; no actual coverage is claimed. Bonferroni avoids an independence assumption but not marginal model assumptions.
entries.unresolved: Prospective simulations and pilot diagnostics must evaluate robust or randomization-based alternatives.

entries.issue: Four-session completion is uncertain; completer covariance may not transport to all recruited participants.
entries.counterexample: Participants with strong vibration discomfort can disproportionately miss later sessions, changing both means and covariance.
entries.repaired: The simple proof is explicitly completer-scoped; outcome-dependent deletion is forbidden and excessive attrition yields DESIGN_NOT_FEASIBLE.
entries.unresolved: No validated IPW, imputation or pattern-mixture sensitivity contract exists.

entries.issue: A nominally blinded pilot can leak condition means or allow analysts to tune clearances, epsilon or transformations.
entries.counterexample: The saved 100-outcome witness doubles size from .05 to .10 when the same outcome selects its favorable tail.
entries.repaired: Pilot outputs are restricted to nuisance/fidelity summaries; confirmatory participants are disjoint; the full plan and code are frozen.
entries.unresolved: Operational role separation and an audit trail need implementation and independent oversight.

entries.issue: Thirty-six complete pilot participants only attain a chosen Gaussian variance-UCB precision factor; it does not ensure practical confirmatory N or ethical feasibility.
entries.counterexample: At half-width .05, an illustrative SD .30 gives a normal screen of 270 confirmatory completers.
entries.repaired: The table is labeled illustrative; N_max and planning clearance must be fixed by scientific/ethical review, and infeasibility is a valid terminal design status.
entries.unresolved: No exact-protocol variance, effect clearance, budget or ethics-approved N_max exists.

entries.issue: A precise covariance model does not repair tendon impurity, readout confounds, decay or normalization dependence.
entries.counterexample: Highly precise localization changes can still be caused by response mapping rather than the intended body pathway.
entries.repaired: All six R161 gates and every R161 gap are inherited; pilot gate failure blocks classification.
entries.unresolved: Actual selectivity and construct validity require independent evidence.

entries.issue: Population covariance and profile decisions do not identify one complete organization, B_min or familiar F_O.
entries.counterexample: Identical physical contrast statistics can coexist with different unmeasured reports, while reports can change without the physical profile.
entries.repaired: The note keeps tokenwise C1, cross-token estimation and phenomenal interpretation separate.
entries.unresolved: Independent selected-target semantics and sufficiency/reflection evidence remain absent.

entries.issue: The theorem proofs are manual; the public-data search is targeted and direct raw-file endpoints were not fully accessible.
entries.counterexample: A future exact crossed dataset or a formalization error could narrow or revise the present result.
entries.repaired: Retrieval failures, finite checks, source scopes and nonclaims are explicit.
entries.unresolved: Independent statistical review, broader data registry search and proof-assistant formalization remain open.

entries.issue: The first rule draft treated the independent-pilot contract as if it entailed valid conditional intervals; independence blocks data reuse but does not establish calibration.
entries.counterexample: A misspecified 80-percent interval remains an 80-percent interval when applied to data independent of the pilot.
entries.repaired: Added R162:PLANWISE_COVERAGE_PREMISE as a separate all_of premise and limited its present discharge to the simple complete Gaussian Bonferroni-Student fallback.
entries.unresolved: Any robust, bootstrap, randomization-based or missingness-adjusted alternative still needs its own planwise proof.
